technology_name: NIR Photovoltaic Power Delivery for Implantable Devices
constitutional_basis: Directive section 11: audit the entire energy chain (optical source -> tissue transmission -> implanted PV -> electrical conversion -> usable device power); every loss explicit; photovoltaic efficiency must never be quoted as implanted-system efficiency. Constitution Art. XXV (unknown stays unknown) and Art. II (exact evidence beats plausibility).
scope: STAGE-BY-STAGE loss map assembled from RECORDED repository values only. Every number carries its evidence class; no number is invented; arithmetic derivations are shown explicitly where computed.
evidence_class_vocabulary: EXTERNAL_PRECEDENT — published-literature value carried in the package (e.g. Jacques 2013 optical properties)
MODELLED — computed/modelled, not measured (Art. XXXVIII layer 4)

T2_CONFIRMED_ASSERTED_NOT_ARCHIVED — claimed as simulation-confirmed in the frozen dossier but the execution artifacts are absent from the repository (R310/R311/R312 cited, not present); not reproducible from repo bytes
COMPUTATIONAL_RESULT — measured on the built CAD solid by the deterministic pipeline
UNKNOWN — not modeled, not measured, not bounded in any committed artifact

chain.notes: R370Q dossier: external source power 'UNKNOWN — bounded by tissue heating limit'. The consultant's plausibility reconstruction used 100 mW/cm² as the assumed incident case (EXTERNAL_PRECEDENT-class assumption, reviewer's arithmetic, not a shipped spec). No source wall-plug efficiency, no skin-interface coupling loss is recorded anywhere.

chain.stage: 2. Tissue transmission (scalp/skull/brain path to implant site)
chain.quantity: Transmitted fraction at the PV surface
chain.value: 5 mm soft tissue: 60.7 % (mu_eff = 1.0 /cm) to 28.7 % (mu_eff = 2.5 /cm); skull composition: WORSE, UNQUANTIFIED in the repository
chain.loss: 39-71 % over 5 mm soft tissue; more through skull (unquantified)
chain.notes: EQ-1 Beer-Lambert I(d) = I0*exp(-mu_eff*d); mu_eff 1.0-2.5 /cm at 940 nm per Jacques 2013 (the package's own EXTERNAL_PRECEDENT). Governing equation committed; path decomposition (skin/scalp/skull/dura) per-layer: UNKNOWN. Implied TOTAL transmission from the 100 mW/cm² consultant case to the recorded PV fluence is 1.0-1.4 % — i.e. an additional ~25-29x 'path losses' beyond the 5 mm soft-tissue figure, consistent with a deeper/optically-worse implant path, which the repo does not decompose.

chain.stage: 3. Fluence at the implanted PV surface
chain.value: 1.0-1.4 mW/cm² (Monte-Carlo converged value 1.049 mW/cm²; published comparison range 0.5-2.0 mW/cm²; MC-vs-MC agreement 0.11 %)
chain.notes: Frozen dossier states 'T2-CONFIRMED via PyTissueOptics v2.0.1' and cites R310/R311/R312 execution directories that DO NOT EXIST in the repository or its git history; the claim's own record labels it MODELLED with limitation 'model prediction — not experimentally verified' and independent_verification 'none'. The R309 pre-registration protocol (MCX vs PyTissueOptics vs Jacques 2013, tolerance 0.05 mW/cm²) IS committed; the execution artifacts are not. This number may not be treated as verified until the runs are repeated or the artifacts restored.

chain.stage: 4. Encapsulation / optical window transmission at 940 nm
chain.quantity: Transmission through the hermetic encapsulation cap
chain.notes: The CAD ships an encapsulation cap (0.55 mm) — its optical material, transmission at 940 nm, and Fresnel/reflection losses are unrecorded. The fluence claim of stage 3 is described as at the PV surface (post-encapsulation or pre-encapsulation is itself unspecified).

chain.quantity: PV module efficiency under implanted conditions (low irradiance ~1 mW/cm², 940 nm, in-vivo temperature)
chain.value: UNKNOWN for the targeted cell; ~30 % cited for GaAs class cells
chain.evidence_class: UNKNOWN (targeted cell) / EXTERNAL_PRECEDENT (~30 % GaAs, consultant-cited literature)
chain.loss: 70 % class (if GaAs ~30 % holds at low irradiance — itself unverified: low-irradiance efficiency can differ substantially from standard-condition efficiency)
chain.notes: R370Q dossier records PV efficiency 'UNKNOWN for targeted PV cell'. Efficiency at ~1 mW/cm² is NOT standard-condition efficiency — using a datasheet number here would be exactly the module-vs-system conflation the directive forbids.

chain.value: 38.485 mm² (= 0.38485 cm²) on the shipped KEEP child (base design 19.635 mm²)
chain.notes: The R381 improvement loop grew the receiver cell diameter 5.0 -> 7.0 mm (area x1.96, KEEP). Measured on the built solid.

chain.quantity: DC power from the PV at the recorded fluence
chain.value: ~1050 uW claimed (MODELLED: 'fluence x area x efficiency' with area and efficiency unstated)
chain.evidence_class: MODELLED — NOT REPRODUCIBLE from recorded inputs
chain.notes: The ~1050 uW figure's formula inputs are not recorded; no committed artifact enumerates them. ARITHMETIC CHECK (shown, on recorded values): 1.049 mW/cm² x 0.38485 cm² x 0.30 = 0.121 mW = ~121 uW — a factor ~8.7 BELOW the claimed 1050 uW. The claim cannot be reproduced from the repository's own recorded numbers and must not be quoted to a buyer as a system output.
No power-management architecture is recorded in the package. Diode/rectification, maximum-power-point tracking, and any duty-cycling storage losses are entirely unmodeled.

chain.quantity: Power available to the implanted device function
chain.value: Target >= 500 uW (post unit-error correction; the pre-correction '>= 500 mW' figure was a confirmed unit error)
chain.notes: Consultant's independent check: 500 uW at ~1 mW/cm² implies ~1.67 cm² of PV at ~30 % efficiency — 4.3x MORE area than the shipped 0.385 cm² receiver. DERIVED DISCREPANCY D2: at the recorded fluence and the consultant GaAs figure, the shipped receiver supports roughly 115-160 uW — BELOW the 500 uW target. The gap must be closed by area, fluence, efficiency, or target revision — all currently open.

derived_discrepancies: D1: The claimed ~1050 uW output is ~8.7x above what the recorded inputs (1.049 mW/cm² x 0.38485 cm² x 0.30) produce (~121 uW). The claim's own formula inputs are unrecorded; it is not reproducible from the repository (Constitution Art. LXII).

D2: The >= 500 uW device target implies ~1.67 cm² receiver area at the recorded fluence (consultant arithmetic) vs 0.385 cm² shipped — a 4.3x area shortfall (or equivalent fluence/efficiency/target adjustment).

D3: The complete loss decomposition (source wall-plug, skin coupling, per-layer tissue including skull, encapsulation, low-irradiance PV efficiency, power electronics) has NEVER existed in one artifact — this file is the first assembly, and it assembles gaps as much as numbers.
module_vs_system_guard: NO number in this budget may be quoted as 'system efficiency' or 'system power'. The only system-level recorded numbers are the fluence range (T2_ASSERTED) and the 500 uW target (BUYER_DEFINED). PV cell efficiency (~30 % GaAs class) is a component figure under non-implanted conditions.
platform_claim_guard: The 'platform technology' framing is NOT supported by repository evidence until (a) the R310/R311/R312 execution artifacts are restored or the simulation chain re-run, and (b) the D1/D2 arithmetic gaps are resolved with recorded inputs. This budget explicitly does not make that claim.

Record encapsulation optical transmission at 940 nm — currently UNKNOWN
